name: x-at-the-range-sentinel-is-absent
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `absent` by range and 0.9 table (bits: the len bits as unsigned), msb, word_bytes 1. Input n = 1 (0x000001), x = 250 (0xfa). x 250 >= 250: absent; x has only a range sentinel, so an absent key writes zero bits as a field with no sentinel (ruling 1 of 0.9): 00. Derived by hand.
